items.title: Meta adds voice and expressive avatars to Muse personal AI agent
items.summary_en: Meta announced a voice mode with expressive avatars for its Muse personal AI agent app, rolling out first in the US. Voice conversations with Muse are described as coming soon to Meta's AI Glasses and Muse Charm.
items.notes: Direct fetch of about.fb.com was blocked (host not in the session's allowed network domains). Content is from a search-result snippet only. The exact day is unknown; the URL shows November 2026, so the date is given at month precision. Verify the day before use.

items.title: Meta expands AI age estimation worldwide for Instagram Teen Accounts
items.summary_en: Meta says it is extending its AI age-estimation technology to all markets, to place more suspected teens into Teen Account protections on Instagram. It reports encouraging results so far. In Australia it has also started using Apple's age-range signal as an extra check.
items.notes: Fetch was blocked; based on search-result summary only. The exact day is unknown (URL shows November 2026). No accuracy figures were found. Earlier rollout steps are in the May 2026 post (https://about.fb.com/news/2026/05/ai-age-assurance-teens/), which is outside the window and is context only.

items.title: Engineering at Meta: new AI tools let Facebook users personalize Feed and Reels in their own words
items.summary_en: Meta's engineering blog describes a set of tools that let people state in natural language what they want to see in Feed and Reels. According to the search summary, the tools use LLMs to store and track those preferences.
items.notes: Fetch was blocked. The date is taken from the URL path. Summary is based on a search snippet only.

items.title: Engineering at Meta: Cuttlefish Android virtual device framework running natively on Apple Silicon
items.summary_en: Meta's engineering blog published a post on running Android's Cuttlefish virtual device framework natively on Apple Silicon Macs. Only the title and a short snippet were available.
items.notes: Fetch was blocked. The date is from the URL path. This is developer tooling and only loosely AI-related, so it is low priority.

items.title: Engineering at Meta: F3 Lightning speeds ads ML feature delivery
items.summary_en: Meta's engineering blog describes F3 Lightning, an internal system for getting ads machine-learning features into production at scale. A search summary reported features shipping about 3.6x faster.
items.notes: Fetch was blocked. The date is from the URL path and falls one day before the preferred window. The 3.6x figure comes from a search snippet and is unverified against the page.

items.title: Meta introduces Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full agent models (older item, context)
items.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, described as frontier models for agents. Per search results, Muse Wonder is available to developers through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, and Muse Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers.
items.notes: Published in October 2026, outside the preferred window. It is included only because it is the model-release context for the November Muse product news. Fetch was blocked; the day is unknown. Treat the capability claims as unverified.

items.title: Meta partners with five US universities on medical and scientific research (older item, context)
items.summary_en: Meta announced $2 million in grants and access to its latest models for research at five US universities, including Caltech and Ohio State, aimed at medical and scientific breakthroughs.
items.notes: Published in October 2026, outside the preferred window. It is included as recent context only. Fetch was blocked; the day is unknown.
